6.A-MeaningfulImage.description: Meaningful images must have text alternatives that serve the equivalent purpose

6.B-DecorativeImage.description: Decorative images must be properly hidden from assistive technology

8.A-ContrastMinimum.description: Text and images of text must have sufficient contrast ratio (4.5:1 regular, 3:1 large)

10.A-FormName.description: Form components must have programmatically determinable accessible names

11.A-PageTitle.description: Web pages must have descriptive titles defined in the title element

13.A-LanguageOfPage.description: The default human language of each web page must be programmatically determinable

14.A-LinkPurpose.description: The purpose of each link must be determinable from the link text or context

15.A-IframeName.description: Each iframe must have an accessible name via the title attribute
